mapper.select: SELECT poi.id, poi.purchase_id AS purchaseId, poi.sku_id AS skuId, p.id AS productId, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, poi.price, poi.qty, poi.amount, poi.is_delete AS isDelete, sku.color_name AS colorName, sku.size_name AS sizeName FROM purchase_order_item poi LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON poi.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN product p ON sku.product_id = p.id WHERE poi.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and poi.is_delete = 0
